mapper.select: select * from ai_config order by provider, model_name
select * from ai_config where is_default = 1 and status = 1 limit 1
select * from ai_config where provider = #{provider} and status = 1 order by is_default desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into ai_config (provider, model_name, api_key, api_base_url, is_default, status, max_tokens, temperature) values (#{provider}, #{modelName}, #{apiKey}, #{apiBaseUrl}, #{isDefault}, #{status}, #{maxTokens}, #{temperature})
mapper.update: update ai_config set is_default = 0 where is_default = 1
update ai_config set is_default = 1 where id = #{id}
